title: Colour palette
slide_intent: Introduce color as its own design decision. A solid field lets readers experience a palette color at the scale of an entire page.
strategic_value: The deep green field can establish continuity across chapters while signaling a pause before detailed guidance.
demonstration: A small section identifier and a large white chapter title occupy the upper left of a dark green page.
practical_value: Use this divider to recognize where the palette rules begin in the book.

content_islands.name: Section identifier
content_islands.spec: Set the number 4.0 and the chapter name on one small line near the upper-left margin.

content_islands.name: Chapter title and field
content_islands.spec: Repeat the name in large white type below the identifier. Extend the dark green ground to every edge.

reference_purposes.Expression: The full dark-green field and large white heading demonstrate the chapter-divider treatment.
